headword: {職務経歴|しょくむけいれき}

definitions.gloss: work history; employment history; career history
definitions.explanation: A record of the jobs and duties a person has performed over their career, especially as presented when applying for a job.

examples.japanese: {職務経歴|しょくむけいれき}を{書|か}く。
examples.english: to write out one's work history

examples.japanese: {応募|おうぼ}には{職務経歴|しょくむけいれき}{書|しょ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: A work history document is required to apply.

examples.japanese: {面接|めんせつ}では{職務経歴|しょくむけいれき}について{詳|くわ}しく{聞|き}かれた。
examples.english: In the interview I was asked in detail about my work history.

notes:
A person's record of past jobs and responsibilities, central to job hunting. Built from {職務|しょくむ} (job duties) and {経歴|けいれき} (career; personal history).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {職務経歴|しょくむけいれき}{書|しょ}: a work-history document (résumé of duties)
- {職務経歴|しょくむけいれき}を{記入|きにゅう}する: to fill in one's work history

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {履歴書|りれきしょ}: résumé; CV — a standard-format personal history form
- {経歴|けいれき}: career; background — broader, not limited to jobs
